author: w0nders
body:
Let me Introduce myself. My name is Etan Meyer. I am 14 years old. I have a lot of experience in different tactics. 

Skype: Awping.6k

Past experiences with a team: Not on this server, but on OCN.

Position: Rusher

Pro's: I am great at pvp, and rushing to monuments and wools.

Con's: Not that great at defense.

Timezone: Pacific

I can help the team push the monuments or wools, and can bridge using various techniques i've learned from OCN and other various 

servers. 

I am very interested in scrimmages also.

Thank you for your time. --Etan
